title: Fold pure-std susi-vendor-tempfile into susi_paths::tempfile, delete crates/susi-vendor-tempfile, and ratchet lean-core ceilings
goal: Reduce Susi Core crate bloat and vendor-facade dependency sprawl under Mandate 69 by folding the zero-dependency pure-std crates/susi-vendor-tempfile leaf into crates/susi-paths/src/tempfile.rs (pub mod tempfile;), deleting crates/susi-vendor-tempfile (-1 workspace crate 50 -> 49, -1 Cargo.lock package 182 -> 181, VENDOR_FACADES 17 -> 16, -8 workspace dev-dependency facade edges), updating all 69 consumer call sites to susi_paths::tempfile, and ratcheting tests/lean_core_ceilings.rs and tests/architecture_tests.rs.

reuse.searched: Searched intellibitz/susi crates/susi-vendor-tempfile/src/lib.rs, crates/susi-paths/src/{lib,hex,shlex,weburl}.rs, susi-commercial-apps, Apache-2.0 temporary-directory crates, and the locked Cargo dependency graph; susi-vendor-tempfile is already a zero-dependency #![forbid(unsafe_code)] pure-std implementation and every consumer crate already depends on susi-paths.
reuse.reason: Folding susi-vendor-tempfile into susi-paths consolidates existing first-party pure-std Rust code, eliminates an entire workspace crate plus 8 dev-dependency facade edges and 1 Cargo.lock package, and adds zero external dependencies.

acceptance: cargo test --offline --locked --test lean_core_ceilings --test architecture_tests && cargo test --offline --locked -p susi-paths --lib

results.tests: susi-paths lib 68 passed, lean_core_ceilings 2 passed, architecture_tests 49 passed, orphan_sources 3 passed, task_records 3 passed, workspace clippy --all-targets 0 warnings
